elastic_pipeline_model.scope: architecture protocol model; requires RTL VCS/SVA before admission

findings.observation: the selected 4x4 architecture is a semantic and protocol-checked predesign, not implemented RTL; the 0.50 ns margin and <=60-level thresholds are gates rather than measured results
findings.required_fix: implement exact-SHA RTL/SVA, replay the M311 oracle and backpressure attacks in VCS, then run the frozen 3 ns TSMC28 DC flow and reject the revision if either timing gate fails

findings.observation: the 2280-2400 um2 range is derived from M314 area plus current-library enabled-flop unit cost; synthesis restructuring, reset coding and buffering can move it
findings.required_fix: replace the estimate with an exact-SHA M320 DC area report

findings.observation: the 256-bit center source remains an external accepted-handshake input and no physical SRAM latency, port, output register or energy is modeled
findings.required_fix: keep SRAM claims false and bind the chosen RTL to a realizable memory interface in a later milestone

m314_critical_path.root_cause: sixteen parallel XOR/popcount candidates feed a source-ordered fifteen-step best-distance/best-center compare-and-mux recurrence; the serial winner recurrence, not candidate Hamming generation alone, dominates depth

comparison.area_estimate_method: M314 baseline plus EDFC cell unit area for added stall-enabled registers; ranges are architectural estimates, not DC results
comparison.reason_to_pay: reduce the popcount-side tournament from three comparator levels to two and balance the two stages around the M314 timing P1

eight_by_two_tournament.description: stage 0 computes sixteen popcounts and two independent eight-way minima; stage 1 compares the two winners and applies guard/tau/output flags
eight_by_two_tournament.timing_risk: smaller register payload but stage 0 carries popcount plus three winner levels, so it is less balanced and gives weaker closure confidence than 4x4

four_by_four_balanced_tournament.description: stage 0 computes sixteen balanced popcounts and four independent four-way minima; stage 1 computes the four-way global minimum and guard/tau/output flags

register_slice_only.description: place an elastic register before the unchanged serial matcher; an output-only slice is smaller but also leaves the matcher path unchanged
register_slice_only.timing_effect: does not split the serial compare/mux recurrence; removing the 0.2 ns external input delay is insufficient evidence for the 0.5 ns target margin

recommended_architecture.name: four_by_four_balanced_tournament
recommended_architecture.popcount_implementation: explicit balanced 16-bit adder tree, not a source-ordered accumulator
recommended_architecture.pre_macro_gate: at frozen 3 ns SDC require worst setup slack >=0.50 ns and <=60 mapped logic levels in every stage; this is a design gate, not a frequency prediction
recommended_architecture.semantic_sideband: carry original pattern, population and tau with the four local winners; never recompute guard or tau from a later transaction
recommended_architecture.stage0: parallel XOR/popcount for sixteen centers, pattern population popcount, four balanced four-way winner trees, then 107-bit payload plus valid elastic register
recommended_architecture.stage1: balanced four-way winner tree, population guard, tau0/tau1 snap decision, selected/original mux and flags into existing 47-bit output payload plus valid register

valid_ready_protocol.reset_rule: reset valid bits; payload reset is unnecessary because invalid payload is don't-care
valid_ready_protocol.update_rule: each stage updates valid and payload only when its ready equation is true; otherwise valid payload must remain stable

recommended_architecture.winner_rule: minimum distance; on equal distance minimum packed unsigned center

required_rtl_sva_vcs_gates: byte-exact equivalence to the M311 serial oracle for center, distance, population, tau, selected/original pattern and all three flags
accepted in_tau must be 0 or 1 for the admitted domain
population below two can never snap even on an exact center
tau0 forbids positive-distance snaps; tau1 admits only distance zero or one
equal-distance distinct centers select the minimum packed unsigned center at both local and global tournament boundaries
stage payload is stable whenever valid and not ready
accepted minus retired equals the two valid-bit occupancy and remains in [0,2]
simultaneous retire, stage transfer and new accept preserves order without duplication or loss
continuous-ready burst covers at least 4096 consecutive accepts and retires after two-cycle fill with II=1
stall both full stages, then release, and cover empty-stage absorption behind a stalled output
scope: read-only timing root-cause and architecture predesign; no RTL, runner, SDC, DC result or docs359 changed

tournament_semantics.ordering_key: (five-bit Hamming distance, sixteen-bit packed unsigned center)
